I guess you run out of memory.

make sure you're using R-4.4 and the most recent testing version of R-INLA

run with fewer threads, like

inla.setOption(num.threads="3:4")

instead of inla.setOption(num.threads="12")

you can add these options

control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb"),
control.compute=list(save.memory=TRUE)
